info.title: Marika's Love Meter Malfunction
info.synopsis: Kanata Kitami è un ragazzo timido che da anni ama la sua amica d'infanzia, Marika Chitose. Una notte desidera di poter capire i sentimenti degli altri e, incredibilmente, il giorno dopo inizia a vedere dei “love meter” sopra le persone: indicatori che mostrano quanto affetto provino per lui. Quando controlla quello di Marika, però, rimane scioccato: il suo indicatore non è solo basso… è sceso sotto lo zero, come se fosse precipitato oltre il limite. Un risultato assurdo, soprattutto perché Marika lo tratta sempre con gentilezza. Determinato a capire quel mistero, Kanata si ritrova coinvolto in equivoci, momenti romantici e piccole rivelazioni, mentre scopre che il cuore di una persona è molto più imprevedibile di qualsiasi misuratore.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Lacking the courage to confess to my childhood friend, Marika, I make a strong wish upon a shooting star. And now, I can see the lovemeters over the girls in my class. Confused by this surreal sight, I look over at Marika, only to find that her meter's had a total meltdown to rotten depths...?! Marika, why is it that you were always so kind to me, then...? What is the real meaning behind the lovemeter...?

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: I've got to do something about my crush, Marika's completely broken lovemeter. First, I figured I should get along with Toyotomi, whose lovemeter is low, but she treats me so harshly, I get discouraged quickly. However, after school, when I help a crying girl at the usual park and take her home, it was Toyotomi's house?! Apparently, the girl was Toyotomi's younger sister! As soon as she invites me to have dinner together as thanks, her lovemeter goes up...

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Racking my brains over what to do with Marika's lovemeter, I bump into my classmate, Mikasa, who was walking her dog at the usual park. Being fellow dog-lovers and sparking conversation over them, her lovemeter is high. I try to act uncool in order to lower Mikasa's lovemeter for the sake of my true love, Marika, but on the contrary...?! Unbeknownst to me, Marika, passing by, witnesses the whole thing...

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: On this day, Marika's lovemeter was completely possessed by a raged and jealous demoness, while she herself had a blank expression. I keep doing my best to approach Marika, not wanting to be disliked. No matter what I did though, she wouldn't smile. But I won't give up. Then, taking a chance, I successfully ask Marika out on a date during lunchtime! But Toyotomi appears before us, and the lovemeter undergoes a sudden change?! In response to that, Marika's lovemeter...

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: I was up on cloud nine after finally landing a date with my beloved Marika at the aquarium. She loves seals, and seeing her carefree smile made it all worth it. But even though I wanted to take things further, I just couldn't muster the courage... Then, during the dolphin show, we end up getting soaked to the bone! Having prepared a change of clothes just in case, I head to our respective changing rooms... But then, the unthinkable happened?!

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: Niino, a tomboyish returnee, transfers to our school, and the boys are buzzing with excitement. For some reason, I couldn't see Niino's lovemeter, but she felt strangely familiar. Why is it that Marika's smiling at me, while my heart's racing over Niino's beauty...? After school, Niino and I end up walking home together and we arrive at the usual park. This place holds so many childhood memories with Marika... Wait, could you be that girl from my memories of playing in the park...?!

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: A demon was dwelling in Marika's lovemeter. During lunch break, while eating with a depressed Marika, Toyotomi comes over. Then, with a girlish expression unimaginable from her usually harsh demeanor, she asks if it's okay to eat lunch together...!? Marika's face darkens, and the demon dwelling in her lovemeter begins to rage! Then Mikasa and Niino join the fray, causing the lovemeters to undergo a climactic change!!!

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: Marika, Toyotomi, Mikasa, and Niino's lovemeters go on a rampage! I feel like I'm being suffocated by all these lovemeters... Just as I thought hard for everyone not to fight over me, I get baptized by the lovemeter only I can see, and I'm on the verge of death. Somehow I manage to confess to Marika, saying she's the one I truly love, but... With that, Marika's lovemeter goes even more completely haywire???!!
